title: Heart Health in Space & SpaceX’s 45-Satellite Night Launch
tagline: Tech, science, and what's actually interesting

stories.title: Spaceflight is hard on the heart, yet artificial ones grow better in space than on Earth
stories.summary: The human heart shrivels away in space, but researchers have found that mini-hearts grown from human stem cells sprout in space significantly faster than in labs on Earth.

stories.title: SpaceX sends 45 satellites to orbit in nighttime launch from California (video)
stories.summary: SpaceX launched 45 satellites to orbit from California early Sunday morning (May 3), including a South Korean spacecraft that was originally supposed to fly in 2022.
